verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot supports natural-language prompts for coding tasks—refactoring, agent-mode feature requests, task assignment via chat/mobile (github-docs-1,2,4,9)—and there's an official CLI/MCP server enabling NL-driven automation (github-probe-3,4). However, evidence is limited to Copilot-specific features rather than broad natural-language control of core GitHub actions, and older community feedback notes inconsistent suggestion accuracy (github-comm-11), so it's a partial, coding-focused agentic experience.
